reference.question: Calculate \(2\cos^2 60^\circ-1\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Substitute the special-angle value

\(\cos 60^\circ=1/2\), so \(2\times(1/2)^2-1=1/2-1=-1/2\). This is \(\cos 120^\circ\).
